name: Checkout Pilot for WooCommerce
author: WP Plugin Pilot

sections.description:
Checkout Pilot for WooCommerce continuously monitors your WooCommerce checkout page to ensure customers can complete purchases without errors. The plugin runs automated diagnostic checks and alerts administrators when checkout issues are detected.

This helps store owners catch problems caused by:
– Plugin conflicts
– Theme updates
– Payment gateway failures
– PHP crashes
– Session/cart issues
– Server misconfigurations

Instead of discovering checkout issues after losing sales, Checkout Pilot detects them automatically.

Key Features

✓ Automated checkout monitoring every 15 minutes
✓ Detect checkout form rendering failures
✓ Session & cart persistence diagnostics
✓ Payment gateway availability detection
✓ PHP error & silent crash monitoring
✓ Instant admin email alerts
✓ WordPress dashboard status widget
✓ Lightweight & no external API required
✓ Works with any WooCommerce theme

What Problems This Plugin Detects

Checkout Pilot helps identify:

  • Checkout page blank or broken
  • Add to cart but checkout not loading
  • Payment gateways not appearing
  • AJAX checkout failures
  • Session expiration issues
  • Fatal PHP errors during checkout
  • WooCommerce update conflicts

How It Works

The plugin runs a scheduled background test that:

  1. Simulates checkout initialization
  2. Validates WooCommerce session
  3. Confirms checkout components load
  4. Checks payment gateway availability
  5. Logs any detected failures
  6. Sends alert emails to admin

If any issue is detected, you’ll be notified immediately.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the checkout-pilot folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active
  4. Visit your WordPress dashboard
  5. View the Checkout Pilot widget for status

No configuration required.
sections.faq:
Does this modify my checkout?

No. The plugin only monitors checkout health. It does not modify WooCommerce behavior.

Will this slow down my store?

No. Monitoring runs in the background using WP-Cron and is extremely lightweight.

Does this work with custom checkout pages?

Yes. It works with most WooCommerce themes and checkout customizations.

How often does it run?

Every 15 minutes by default.

Does it support Elementor / custom builders?

Yes. It monitors checkout availability regardless of builder.
